shebang.comment: Only meaningful at byte offset zero.
shebang.name: comment.line.shebang.tosh

patterns.comment: Doc comment with a named tag: @param=name / @typeparam=name
patterns.name: comment.line.documentation.tosh

patterns.comment: Doc comment with a block tag
patterns.name: comment.line.documentation.tosh

comment.comment: A lone '#' opens a comment only when it stands alone as a word: at the start of a word and followed by whitespace or end of line. That is what leaves #ff0000, issue#42 and C# as ordinary barewords.
comment.name: comment.line.number-sign.tosh

raw-triple-string.comment: """..."""  — raw, multi-line, no escapes or interpolation
raw-triple-string.name: string.quoted.triple.tosh

single-quoted-string.comment: Single-quoted strings are literal — no escapes or interpolation
single-quoted-string.name: string.quoted.single.tosh

type-definition.comment: Refinement type alias:  type Port = int where (...)

subcommand-definition.comment: subcommand blocks turn a script into a structured CLI

subcommand-member.comment: flag / arg declarations inside a subcommand body

operator-definition.comment: Operator overloads: func +(o), func ==(o), func !=(o). The name is punctuation, so #function-definition's identifier pattern never matches these.

declaration-modifiers.comment: Modifier run before a declaration keyword. `global` and `export` are visibility keywords rather than storage modifiers, so they need their own scope here.

generic-arguments.comment: Type arguments glued to a name: Vector2D<T>, dict<string, int>. The no-space lookbehind keeps `a < b` a comparison.

member-declaration.comment: Field names in raw struct bodies and native bind signatures: `uptime: long`, `sysname: cstring[65]`.

member-access.comment: Dotted member access on a bareword receiver: Info.raw_info.uptime. `$`-prefixed paths are already consumed whole by #variable-reference.

patterns.comment: Capitalised receiver reads as a type or module
patterns.name: entity.name.type.tosh

patterns.comment: Generic constraint: where T: Numeric. The optional group keeps a bare `where` (pipeline filter, refinement clause) matching too.

cast-expression.comment: Type-test and cast operators:  $x as int,  $x is not string

patterns.comment: Parameter / property type annotation:  name: Type
Static member access on a CLR type:  String.Join(...)

function-reference.comment: &name is a function reference at the start of an expression; a trailing & backgrounds the pipeline.

patterns.comment: $this is the receiver, so it reads as a member rather than as a language keyword: most themes render variable.language in a bright keyword red, which is wrong for a value you dot into.
patterns.name: variable.other.member.this.tosh

patterns.comment: _.Member access on the current pipeline item

builtin-commands.comment: Built-in commands, highlighted in command position. Alternation is longest-first so 'read' cannot shadow 'read-file'.

command-position.comment: These matches begin at the whitespace before the word, so they start earlier than a keyword match on the word itself and would otherwise win the tie. NOT_KEYWORD keeps `{ return ...` and `for x in ...` from being scoped as command calls.

patterns.comment: Command position: start of line, after ; { ( or =>, or after a pipe that is not a {| record opener.

parameter-name.comment: Parameter names in signatures — after '(' or ',', and after the native binding modes 'out' and 'ref'.

redirection.comment: Named-stream redirection: out> o>> err> e> o+e> err+out>> and <<<

patterns.comment: Floor division. Spaces required so paths keep their slashes.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.arithmetic.tosh

patterns.comment: ISO temporal instants — must precede the duration rule
patterns.name: constant.numeric.datetime.tosh

patterns.comment: IPv4 literal — four explicit octets, no leading zeroes
patterns.name: constant.numeric.ip.tosh
